{{Top|leg}}
'''Gorgands''' were predators from [[Trinta]] attuned to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. They were large, predatory [[Feline/Legends|felines]], and its body and eyes glowed red. Once [[Death/Legends|killed]], the gorgand convulsed and split its skin open from head to tail, releasing its intestines which attempted to strangle its prey.
